# vantage

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/vantage>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)

The agent or standpoint from which the observation is made — the reified-object-property counterpart of [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md). Semantically, [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) ⊑ [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md): when an annotated statement is promoted to a reified [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md), its [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) becomes the [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) of the relator. The agent in the vantage role — an observer, a sensor, a perceiver — IS a standpoint ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)): no frame is privileged, and every vantage is a co-equal facet from which the claim is held. Range is [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) (encompassing both [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) and [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md)) because a vantage may be a bare agent (person, organization, software agent, sensor) or a [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) individual when the frame needs its own identity. Non-functional: joint observations (a reading co-authored by two agencies) are valid.

## Usage Advice

### Scope notes

- [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) ⊑ [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md): the reified relator edge is semantically subsumed by the annotation-property axis. This is NOT asserted as [rdfs:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf) because [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) is an [owl:AnnotationProperty](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#AnnotationProperty) (keeping the OWL 2 DL downcast clean, [Principle 3](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-3)) while vantage is an [owl:ObjectProperty.](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#ObjectProperty.) The subsumption is documented here and realised in the projection layer, not axiomatised in the reasoned core.
